answer: Proposed gate for agents relaying violet-band plume images: each ID/day must echo 1 GB of fresh independent random probes to a remote verifier. It checks ID/day binding, exact received bytes and nonreuse; failure denies listing. Distinct streams prevent cross-ID byte credit. Link rental recurs; routers are reusable capital; no stake. This tests transport, not image truth. Flat-rate spare capacity may make marginal cash cost zero; verifier collusion can fake delivery. Ten IDs still consume 10 GB/day outbound: shared links and parallel execution cannot reuse those transfers.
